cast.title: Agnipariksha
cast.overview: Raja Babu is in love with a beautiful young woman and wishes to marry her. However, his life changes after she suddenly passes away in an accident.

cast.title: Gulab
cast.overview: The film delves into the life of a young couple. On their anniversary celebration, a text SMS changes the life of the male protagonist.

cast.title: Teen Yaari Katha
cast.overview: The story narrates three adult boy's life from three different background.

cast.title: Paharganj Halt
cast.overview: A quaint little town with a promise of rare stories.

cast.title: Dui
cast.overview: Dui is the story of an uncompromising school teacher who love teaching slum-dwelling children for free. When his daughter is brutally raped and commits suicide, he tries to fight a politically corrupted AITC leader. One of his students takes the case. Will he win?

cast.title: Ektu Sore Boshun
cast.overview: It follows the journey of Guddu who is a Sanskrit graduate from the small town of Begunbagicha, and literally wastes his time roaming around, being jobless and aimless in life. His friends are just like him. While Guddu’s parents are a bit eccentric, his only shining light in life is his childhood love Piu. The plot revolves around Guddu and he’s surrounded by many oddball characters. Guddu finally comes to Kolkata for a job opportunity and interestingly his love interest follows him as well.

cast.title: Moner Manush
cast.overview: The movie is about a poet and singer Lalon Fakir who belongs to a cult called baul and who believes and inculcates that the value of a human being is above the narrow belief of religions.

cast.title: Kagojer Bou
cast.overview: Subimal promises Upal money if he manages to help Subimal get close to Preeti.

cast.title: Sada Canvas
cast.overview: Anjan, a famous artist, experiences a spell of creative block. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when an art student, Ria, enters his life.

cast.title: Rangamati
cast.overview: Simulpur is a village that believes in superstition so much that the local zamindar uses this ignorance to his advantage until they are all awoken from their ignorance by Parul who is labelled a witch.

cast.title: Palan
cast.overview: Kaushik Ganguly will bring the story of dismissal in his new film ‘Palan’ in the context of 2022. The characters of Kharij will remain the same, the names will not change. The story will change a bit to keep pace with the context of this era.

cast.title: Hate Story
cast.overview: Journalist Kavya Krishna loves tycoon Siddharth - who uses and abuses her. How far will Kavya go to get revenge?

cast.title: Mushrooms
cast.overview: In a forest, near a border, a young Bengali and a European soldier attempt to get the better of one another. In Calcutta, Rahul, an architect who had gone off to build a career in Dubai, begins a huge construction site. He is reunited with his girlfriend, Paoli, who has long awaited his homecoming, living alone far from her family. Both set out to find Rahul's brother, who is said to have gone mad and who lives in the forest and sleeps in the trees.

cast.title: Tulkalam
cast.overview: The sudden boom in industrialisation threatens to take away the fertile lands from a village wherein honest, hard-working people work to make a living.

cast.title: Someday Somewhere, Jete Pari Chole...
cast.overview: A young girl named Ruu went on a vacation with her family. She was unhappy. A young Sikkimese Car Driver cum guide helps her to come out of her trauma as he takes her to visit Kanchanjungha, the snow clad mountain range. She reveals that her days are numbered as she is HIV positive and an AIDS victim. She decides to stay back in the lap of the Himalayas for ever.

cast.title: I Love You
cast.overview: A rich young man must prove his love for a simple village belle; she is humiliated by his family, so he opts to rusticate with hers.

cast.title: Teen Murti
cast.overview: Nawren, Nawgen and Nobin, three friends enjoying their retirement, decide to end the monotony in their lives and earn some extra money by setting up a tea stall.

cast.title: Byomkesh Hotyamancha
cast.overview: Set in the tumultuous Naxalite uprising in Bengal in 1971, Byomkesh Bakshi gets involved in a story of vengeance when he decides to attend a play at the theatre and becomes witness to a crime unfolding on the center stage. As Byomkesh digs deep into the case, it opens him to a tripartite story of love, betrayal, and infidelity. And how the mystery is laid bare for Byomkesh to solve.

cast.title: Maya Mridanga
cast.overview: This is about psychology of artistes and the varied motivations that drive them. With music being the central theme, the film revolves around the live of the folk musician Birbhum, Jhakshu.

cast.title: Ankur Arora Murder Case
cast.overview: Romesh (Arjun Mathur) was a young medical intern who dared to dream. He was in awe of Dr. Asthana (Kay Kay Menon), the Chief of Surgery of the Shekhawat General Hospital. All he wanted to was be like him. He lived in with Riya, his co-intern and the love of his life.  However, when an eight year old boy, Ankur dies due to Dr. Asthana's medical negligence, Romesh realises that a good surgeon is not necessarily a good person.  Together with Ankur's mother Nandita, Dr Romesh sets out on a turbulent journey to fight for what is right. A fight for justice against his mentor, the hospital and the love of his life

cast.title: The Terrace
cast.overview: Perturbed with her married responsibilities, a writer and a school teacher’s identity issues trigger when she is denied access to the terrace - her open space. A story of longing, resilience, and the quiet strength of a woman

cast.title: Hoichoi
cast.overview: Hoi Choi is a film dealing with the nitty gritty's of theatre and do not shy away from showing the adversities of the same too

cast.title: Natoker Moto: Like a Play
cast.overview: Kheya, a theatre artist, faces challenges in her personal and professional life spanning from 1950 to 1970s in a world dominated by misogynistic men.

cast.title: Black Coffee
cast.overview: Saswata, Paoli and Badshah in Atanu Bose film.

cast.title: Tobu Aporichito
cast.overview: A married couple who start on the wrong side and detest each other eventually grow close and learn to appreciate and love each other.

cast.title: Obhishopto Nighty
cast.overview: The story of the film revolves around a cursed nightie which changes hands in a logical manner, not magically. The original owner of the nightie had experienced unfulfilled love, which ultimately led to a curse on it.  A wannabe actress comes to Kolkata from a village in pursue of her career. She can cross all limits in order to become successful. She uses that nightie for seducing producers and she doesn't regret in what she is doing. The events that take place later form the climax of the story.

cast.title: Banshiwala
cast.overview: Mridul suffers a huge loss in his business and decides to return to his ancestral house for selling the property. However, the property is taken care of by an old headmaster and his daughter Lakshmi.

cast.title: Prime Time
cast.overview: The film revolves around the journey of beautiful Chandana and tough Sayantan who are crime reporters. They operate together and find exclusive and breaking news for their channel.

cast.title: Ajob Prem Ebong...
cast.overview: This is a black comedy about a complex relationship between a bus, its conductor and the widow of a villager who was run over by the bus in an accident. Set in an Indian village, the story ...

cast.title: Parapaar
cast.overview: Communication gaps surface when a man returns home after a 14 year prison term and is finally forced to take his tormentor head on

cast.title: Baga Beach
cast.overview: Five teenagers struggle to live in the commercialized world in the backdrop of Goan tourism. Their dreams and aspirations will change forever after one of them will be subjected to sexual abuse.

cast.title: Jamai Raja
cast.overview: A woman can inherit her father's fortune only if she gets married sooner. She ties the knot with an poor man who is in dire need of money.

cast.title: Yaara Silly Silly
cast.overview: After spending time with a prostitute, a man later meets her on a train where their fond memories are rekindled and their romance blossoms

cast.title: Gang of Ghosts
cast.overview: A group of ghosts reside in an old house and live in harmony despite cultural differences. However, when they learn that a builder plans to demolish the building, they band together to stop him.

cast.title: Calcutta My Love
cast.overview: The violence and upheaval of Calcutta in the 1970s is focalized through a young man coming to the city to study.

cast.title: The Bait
cast.overview: The way that people are used as bait is explored through three stories about three different characters.

cast.title: Box No. 1313
cast.overview: Joy's parents are busy searching for a suitable match for him, but are cheated by matchmakers. Meanwhile, Joy falls in love with an air-hostess who doesn't show interest in him. Will Joy convince her?

cast.title: Asamapta - Incomplete
cast.overview: Indrajit (played by the consistently stellar Ritwick Chakraborty) is an intelligent if indecisive man of 35 on holiday from Kolkata to visit his old college friend Moloy. He arrives to find Moloy constantly battling with his neglected wife Tuki, a formidable woman seeking elsewhere for the tenderness she fails to receive at home. In town, Indrajit comes across a familiar man whose insistence that they’ve never met before clearly masks an intriguing secret. Then, Indrajit runs into an old lover and her jealous husband, setting the stage for some fierce confrontation.

cast.title: Zulfiqar
cast.overview: A modern day adaptation of two of William Shakespeare's tragedies - Julius Caesar and Antony and Cleopatra.

cast.title: Khawto
cast.overview: A young couple meet a mysterious man who, in the course of conversation, covers Japanese cuisine, Bengali literature, and his own checkered past.

cast.title: Aroni Tokhon
cast.overview: Aroni Takhon is a love story set against the time period between the two horrific events, the demolition of the Babri Masjid on 6th December, 1992 and the Godhra train burn on 28th February, 2002. The film showcases the effects of such macro events and how everyone knowingly or unknowingly are affected by it.

cast.title: Hercules
cast.overview: Hercules is the story of a common man: His actual name is Harakailash, his timid nature and compromising attitude has prompted the local people to call him Hercules in jest.

cast.title: Maacher Jhol
cast.overview: A world-renowned chef returns to his roots through a bowl of fish curry, the quintessential Bengali delicacy.

cast.title: Ahare Mon
cast.overview: A heartwarming collage of inter-connected love stories, Ahare Mon is a romantic drama that revolves around people who are otherwise forbidden to fall in love.

cast.title: Halkaa
cast.overview: Halkaa is a story of a eight year old boy who lives in the slums of delhi and wants proper access to a toilet. This story is of a boy who is a real life Superhero who fights against the system to get what he wants and deserves.

cast.title: Mandobasar Golpo
cast.overview: With the assistance of a psychiatrist, an acclaimed filmmaker struggles to come to terms with a mysterious romantic trauma.

cast.title: Family Album
cast.overview: This is a movie that exposes the not-so picture-perfect Family Album...a hilarious and sad and eccentric concoction of the truth.

cast.title: Swatta
cast.overview: A bohemian encounters a woman with whom a love affair ensues.

cast.title: Tritio Adhyay
cast.overview: Tritio Adhyay is a romantic thriller that redefines the boundaries of love through its characters : their sacrifices, their passion and their retribution. When Koushik on his own mission stumbles upon his ex-girlfriend Shreya in a small town in Jharkhand, their lives change forever. The demons from the past rears its ugly head, and thereon begins a nightmare of a dark thrilling ride to its ultimate destination...the victory of Love.

cast.title: Maati
cast.overview: Meghla, who after years discovers that her grandmother had been killed in her ancestral home in East Pakistan by a trusted retainer of the family. And many years after the tragedy, she visits Dhaka to trace her roots and faces the murderer's family who now occupies her house. Maati traces Meghla's trials with truth and humanity while tackling issues of migration, human displacement, and relationships.

cast.title: Konttho
cast.overview: Arjun Mallik is a popular RJ who is not only famous but well-loved. His listeners connect with him personally and his voice is music to their ears. However, his perfect life comes to an absolute halt when he is diagnosed with throat cancer. A story of hope, a story of friendship, a story of struggle - Konttho, is about the indomitable human spirit.

cast.title: Shantilal O Projapoti Rohoshyo
cast.overview: A deadbeat weather reporter at an English newspaper in Kolkata evolves into a detective when he pursues a deeply buried story about an adult movie star.

cast.title: Elar Char Adhyay
cast.overview: Indranath is a leader of a group which is fighting for Indian independence. Ela is the teacher of the group. Ela is caught in a dilemma between her love for Atindra and her commitment towards her country.

cast.title: Hukumat Ki Aandhi
cast.overview: Local Bhojpuri politicians fight each other and unleash terror on villages in order to grab land from poor farmers after Pramod, a righteous young leader, dies.

cast.title: Sanjhbati
cast.overview: Sulekha, a lonely elderly woman, misses her son who lives in a different country but finds comfort in the company of her caretakers.

cast.title: Love Aaj Kal Porshu
cast.overview: Two people whose love is a force that can never be changed, no matter how much its surroundings may change. A unique take on the timelessness of romance.

cast.title: Takhan Teish
cast.overview: Takhan Teish is a 2010 Bengali film directed Atanu Ghosh which was premiered at the 6th Osaka International Film Festival, Japan. It is Ghosh's second feature film.

cast.title: Devi
cast.overview: It's an adaptation and deconstruction of an age old classic, 'DEVDAS', by the great Bengali writer Sharatchandra Chattopadhyay. In this film the gender of the main characters has been reversed and all of them are placed in twenty-first century.

cast.title: Chaya Manush
cast.overview: When your life is sinking he comes to you as your Saviour but in turn leaves you destructed. Who is this man in shadows and what exactly does he want from the protagonists forms the story of the film.

cast.title: Password
cast.overview: A police officer tracks down a cyber criminal that hacks the passwords of innocent people in order to destroy their lives.

cast.title: Bulbbul
cast.overview: A child bride grows up to be an enigmatic woman presiding over her household, harboring a painful past as supernatural murders of men plague her village.

cast.title: Holud Bani
cast.overview: The story of the film focuses on a love triangle, revolves around a middle-class man who travels to a place called holud bani along with a single woman in search of a job. There, his meeting with a hot girl would change his life completely.

cast.title: Thana Theke Aschi
cast.overview: A suspect is looked for by an eligible police officer after a women allegedly committed suicide...

cast.title: Raat Baaki Hai
cast.overview: It's a story of one night where estranged lovers Kartik and Vasuki end up meeting each other after 12 years under strange circumstances. Kartik is on a run for being a murder suspect. However, there is more than what meets the eye.

cast.title: Mirchi Malini
cast.overview: A thriller about a food taster, who can know everything about you by tasting the food you have made...even your darkest secrets.

cast.title: Three Course Meal
cast.overview: An Hindi Anthalogy Created by Three Bengali Directors

cast.title: Tara
cast.overview: Madhuja faces a corrupt system as she tries to free her father who has been wrongfully arrested.

cast.title: Abhijaan
cast.overview: A tribute to the life and accomplishments of the legendary Bengali actor Soumitra Chatterjee, who was a pioneer in Indian cinema with a career spanning seven decades.

cast.title: Ajana Batas
cast.overview: Deepa, a copywriter, lives in the city, away from her Ranaghat home town. She stays with her uncle and is very close to him. They share a unique bond of friendship.

cast.title: Bedroom
cast.overview: Deb, Joy, and Ananda are unhappy with their lives. While Joy's wife earns more than he does, Ananda‘s wife is a housewife and Deb is a kind of man who wants to sleep with any girl who catches his eye. Will their bedroom stories forever be the same or will they make an effort to get along well with each other?

cast.title: Chawlochitro Circus
cast.overview: Chawlochitro Circus is based on the life of a Bengali filmmaker who tries to make a film but faces many obstructions. It showcases the struggles of a film director in a funny way.

cast.title: Shob Charitro Kalponik
cast.overview: The sudden death of Indraneel, a poet, averts a possible divorce and takes Radhika on a fantastic inward journey of discovering her own roots through the language of poetry and lost love. A publisher asks Radhika to complete Indraneel's works. This compels her to study his work, and thus begins her journey into the past.

cast.title: Bibi Payra
cast.overview: When two overlooked women hit their breaking point, they take bold, reckless steps to change their lives. With limited power and unexpected allies, they dive into a chaotic plan that quickly turns into a comedy of errors.

cast.title: Lokkhikantopur Local
cast.overview: Lokkhikantopur Local movie deals with the life ordeals of house helps Kalyani, Maloti and Saraswati, visiting three different families in Kolkata.

cast.title: Aamar Pratigya
cast.overview: Shiva leaves no stone unturned to fight for his brother in order to reunite his family and bring back their lost happiness.

crew.title: Calcutta My Love
crew.overview: The violence and upheaval of Calcutta in the 1970s is focalized through a young man coming to the city to study.
